lines.text: Time to build your first real game!
Move a bowl with the arrow keys and catch the falling apples.
The bowl moves left and right with the arrow keys.
An apple falls from a random place at the top.
If the apple touches the bowl, play a sound and drop a new apple. If it reaches the bottom, drop a new apple too.
It falls in a forever loop, and two if blocks check: touching the bowl? And at the bottom?
The bowl starts at the bottom and moves with the arrow keys — just like Lesson 2!
Game designers test their games again and again.
If it is too easy, make the apple fall faster. Ask a friend to play and watch what they do.
In the next module you will add a score. Now build your game!
